headings.usage: Used for all massive hero text, section titles, and profile names to convey high-end elegance.

body.usage: Used for all functional text, pricing, descriptions, and UI elements. Clean and geometric to contrast the serif.

layout_strategy.general: Embrace the 'Anti-Grid' aesthetic. Overlapping sections, ample negative space, and generous padding (py-24 to py-32). Avoid rigid columns where possible to create a fluid, mysterious journey.
layout_strategy.cards: Glassmorphism with sculpted feel. backdrop-blur-xl, subtle 1px border of rose_gold/20, soft inner glow shadow. Must not look like standard SaaS cards.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for inner card padding. gap-8 or gap-12 for grids.
layout_strategy.hero: Full viewport height (100vh). Heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60) over background video/image. Content centered or offset left with massive serif typography.
layout_strategy.navigation: Crystal glass header. Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0A0A0B]/70 with 1px border-b border-white/5.
layout_strategy.footer: Massive padding (py-20), dark background (#050505). Large brand typography, discrete links.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#B76E79] to-[#D4AF37] text-white font-medium px-8 py-3 rounded-none hover:brightness-110 transition-all duration-300 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#B76E79] text-[#E0BFB8] hover:bg-[#B76E79]/10 px-8 py-3 rounded-none transition-all duration-300 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.whatsapp_floating: fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(37,211,102,0.4)] hover:scale-110 transition-transform z-50 flex items-center justify-center

cards.profile: relative group overflow-hidden bg-[#121214]/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 hover:border-[#B76E79]/40 transition-colors duration-500
cards.pricing: p-8 border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#121214] to-[#0A0A0B] relative hover:border-[#D4AF37]/50 transition-all duration-500

modals.age_verification: Fixed inset-0 z-[100] backdrop-blur-3xl bg-black/90 flex items-center justify-center. Content box uses sculpted glassmorphism with strong gold accents.

animations_and_interactions.hover_states: Profile cards should have slow scale-up on images (duration-700 ease-out). Borders transition to rose gold.
animations_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Elements should reveal on scroll (fade-up and slight blur removal) to create a 'discovery' feel.
animations_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Buttons have a subtle inner glow on hover. Text links use an expanding underline effect (left to right).

sections: Hero (Video/Image background, massive 'Kıbrıs Night Club', CTA: View Gallery)
About/Intro (Editorial layout, overlapping image and text, SEO H2)
Featured Profiles (Bento grid or horizontal scroll of top girls)
Services Preview (List of services with icon on left, text on right, hover effects)

gallery.layout: Grid cols-1 sm:cols-2 lg:cols-3 xl:cols-4 gap-6. Each card shows photo, name, age, height, languages, rate.
gallery.features: Filters (New, VIP, etc.). Hover on card reveals stats overlay.

services.layout: Alternating text/image layout (zig-zag). Each service gets massive typography and generous spacing.

pricing.layout: 3-column pricing table. Highlight the 'VIP' package with a gold border and subtle pulsating glow.

contact.layout: Split layout: Left side contact details & WhatsApp link, Right side discreet contact form (Shadcn customized).

blog.layout: Masonry or standard grid for articles. Heavy focus on SEO keywords in titles.

faq.layout: Shadcn Accordion customized to fit dark theme (border-b white/10, text-white/80, open state turns text to rose gold).

media.style_guidance: Tasteful, luxury-oriented. Emphasize lighting, shadows, and silhouettes. Avoid explicit content. Focus on the 'experience' (champagne, high-end interiors, elegant evening wear).

image_urls.description: Dark background with pink lights, suitable for moody hero overlay.
Couple holding champagne glasses, perfect for Services or About section.
Graceful woman portrait, dark and elegant. Use as placeholder for profile cards.
Mysterious portrait of woman with veil. Use as placeholder for profile cards.

technical_requirements.seo: Meta titles/descriptions must dynamically inject 'Girne Kıbrıs Eskort' and translations. Use Next-SEO or react-helmet.
technical_requirements.i18n: Implement i18next or similar. Default language: tr. Switcher in header.
technical_requirements.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios for text over dark backgrounds. Provide aria-labels for all WhatsApp/Call icon buttons.
technical_requirements.mobile: Mobile nav should be a full-screen dark overlay menu. Ensure gallery grids drop to 1 column on mobile to keep profile images large and impactful.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this blueprint using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and page transitions. The 'age verification' modal MUST load before any content is interactive. Prioritize the dark luxury aesthetic: use the rose_gold and gold hex codes meticulously for borders, hover states, and key typography.
